text: A use of an uninitialized value occurs in the optimal parser when evaluating the cost of adding one more literal near the end of the input block. The code computes `LIT_PRICE(ip + cur)` without first enforcing that `ip + cur < iend`, so it can read the literal cost from past the valid input and pass an uninitialized byte value into the literal cost calculation in `ZSTD_rawLiteralsCost()`.
